releases.name: v0.1.4 – Engram sidebar fixes for attach mode
releases.body:
## What's Changed

- Fixed Engram sidebar health and project resolution when using `opencode attach`
- Added `all_projects=true` to observations/sessions queries for correct project derivation
- Improved health aggregation in `CompositeEngramAdapter` to combine local and cloud status
- Added dynamic workspace path resolution using `api.state.path` in attach sessions
- Updated README.md with explicit instructions for `opencode attach` and the `🔌 Target:` debug line
- Published opencode-flema-engram-sidebar@0.1.4 to NPM
- Fixed GitHub Page logo (temporary CSS brain mark; ready for custom image)

## Details

This release resolves the issue where the sidebar showed `OFFLINE` and `Project: unresolved` when using `opencode attach <url>`. The plugin now correctly loads from NPM, detects the attach URL, queries Engram with `all_projects=true`, aggregates health status, and uses the remote workspace path.

See the sidebar debug line `🔌 Target: Local=<host>:7437 | Cloud=<URL>` to confirm connection targets.

[View the changelog on GitHub](https://github.com/oniricosistemas/flema-engram/compare/v0.1.3...v0.1.4)

## Flema Engram 0.1.2

- Exporta el plugin TUI por defecto desde la raíz del paquete.
- Mantiene los exports MCP nombrados.
- OpenCode puede configurarse con el spec simple opencode-flema-engram-sidebar.
- Actualiza la documentación del flujo de instalación.

Fix reactive sidebar refresh rendering after Alt+R. Preserve project-scoped observations across Flema and other OpenCode repositories. Synchronize the MCP default version with package metadata. Published npm package version opencode-flema-engram-sidebar@0.1.1. Verification: 204 tests passed, typecheck passed, build passed, package verifier passed, GitHub CI passed.
